Week of July 5

Filed under: #weekly

I totally forgot to do it this Sunday and only just remembered. Oops.

I've just been working on my UTAU and drawing. Additionally, I've been playing Pronoun Palace since my friend bought it for our Steam Family and it's so much fun! I have a large vocabulary, so I'm glad to finally use it in one of my favorite game genres (roguelike).

I lost my Apple Pencil on Thursday. I have been distraught ever since. I think I left it with my therapist, so I'll have to check with her this Thursday. If not, then I guess I have to sacrifice $100 for a new one. All of this during Art Fight month, too, how unfortunate.

My current setup is Krita with my pen tablet, but my laptop doesn't even support pen pressure (seriously). I do kind of miss using Krita, though.

And this week I've just been doing stuff to my UTAU. I rerecorded them...again. A rererecording, if you will. You may be like, you've been working on your UTAU for such a long time, what's the holdup? The holdup is that I've never done this before and refuse to ask for help, so I keep messing up on simple things that I have to redo over and over.

But that's part of the fun, really.

...Hmm. Goal for next week: don't forget this time, maybe? Otherwise continue as I have been doing.
